site_summary.content_boundary: Structure and copy shape only. Bring new project nouns, facts, claims, audience, domain, and offers.

measurement_note: Numeric ranges are drift checks for benchmarking, not the primary writing method.

page_blueprint.goal: Orient the reader before the first claim.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Use short noun-led labels; keep utility paths separate from product paths.

page_blueprint.goal: State the main outcome and give a visible next action.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Specific headline, one compact value sentence, and one or two action CTAs.

page_blueprint.goal: Explain the product through repeated value, proof, and action blocks.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Specific heading, short proof sentence, compact CTA.

page_blueprint.goal: Make the promise believable without overclaiming.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Use concrete evidence blocks: metric, customer type, workflow step, or product constraint.

page_blueprint.goal: Give deeper readers enough structure to evaluate fit.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Alternate short headings with one-paragraph explanations and compact lists.

page_blueprint.goal: Repeat the next action after value and proof are established.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Short reminder sentence plus one primary action CTA.

page_blueprint.goal: Close with utility, trust, and legal/support paths.
page_blueprint.copy_shape: Grouped utility links with short labels and no marketing prose.

section_recipes.goal: Orient the reader before the first claim.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Use short noun-led labels; keep utility paths separate from product paths.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Use navigation categories from the new product, not the reference source.

section_recipes.goal: State the main outcome and give a visible next action.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Specific headline, one compact value sentence, and one or two action CTAs.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Name the new outcome plainly before explaining features.

section_recipes.goal: Explain the product through repeated value, proof, and action blocks.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Specific heading, short proof sentence, compact CTA.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Keep each section tied to a real product capability.

section_recipes.goal: Make the promise believable without overclaiming.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Use concrete evidence blocks: metric, customer type, workflow step, or product constraint.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Only include proof that the new project can independently support.

section_recipes.goal: Give deeper readers enough structure to evaluate fit.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Alternate short headings with one-paragraph explanations and compact lists.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Split detail by user job, workflow step, or decision criterion.

section_recipes.goal: Repeat the next action after value and proof are established.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Short reminder sentence plus one primary action CTA.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Repeat the real conversion action; do not add urgency unless it is true.

section_recipes.goal: Close with utility, trust, and legal/support paths.
section_recipes.copy_shape: Grouped utility links with short labels and no marketing prose.
section_recipes.agent_rule: Use owned support, policy, company, and resource links.

agent_instructions: Use SITE.md for page structure and section order.
Use VOICE.md for sentence rhythm, CTA shape, and benchmark gates.
Treat the new project brief as the only source of product category, audience, domain nouns, examples, offers, and claims.
Replace every topic, product noun, market claim, price, and proof point with facts from the new project.
Do not imply affiliation with, endorsement from, or official representation of the reference source.
If a needed fact is missing, write a neutral placeholder or remove the claim.
anti_patterns: Do not copy source headings, CTA labels, navigation labels, slogans, or campaign names.
Do not import the reference site's product catalog, category, audience, pricing, legal claims, feature names, people, events, or cultural context.
Do not turn structure guidance into a visual design system.
Do not add urgency, security, performance, customer, or compliance claims without evidence.
